main.description: Summarize a space's index: its declared model, how many memories are indexed, and which authors have memories that weren't indexed because their vectors don't match the space's model. Same authentication as garden.engram.searchMemories.

config.description: The space's garden.engram.config, as last seen.

buildingMemories.description: During a model change: memories that already have a vector for the next model.

errors.name: UnknownSpace
errors.description: This service does not index the space.

access.description: Whether the appview may read the space, to keep its index current.

state.description: granted: the authority granted read access. missing: nobody has; the index isn't updated. lapsed: the authority's server refused the grant the last time it was used; grant again.
